title: Enums with associated values
hints: Look at the README's 'New syntax' (switch with `let`, `init?`, `CaseIterable`). `area` needs one `case` per shape; `Suit` needs only a conformance.
Idea: `area` switches on `self` and pulls out each case's numbers; the parser splits the text on spaces, then decides by word count and first word, returning nil for anything else.
Example on other data: `case .card(let last4): ...`, `case let .split(a, b): ...`, and `"move 3".split(separator: " ").map(String.init)` → `["move", "3"]`.
Near-answer: `case let .rect(width, height): return width * height`; in the init: `case 2 where parts[0] == "go": self = .go(parts[1])`, `default: return nil`; and `enum Suit: CaseIterable { ... }`.
